title: One kind of tip
lines: Tips look and work the same in town, the Works and the Little Raid. Pointing at something shows its name and a line at once; keep pointing to see its whole card. A click keeps it open.
On a phone, a long press on a button shows its tip, and it stays open until you tap somewhere else. A card opens along the top of the screen when along the bottom it would cover what you tapped.
